name: foldwing
description: Foldwing — draw one line, its mirror has to survive too.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm test && vite build
scripts.build:test: npm run build && node scripts/check-ad-mode.mjs test
scripts.build:adsoff: VITE_AD_MODE=test VITE_ADS=off npm run build && node scripts/check-ad-mode.mjs off
scripts.build:mock: VITE_AD_MODE=test VITE_ADS=mock npm run build && node scripts/check-ad-mode.mjs mock
scripts.build:live: VITE_AD_MODE=live npm run build && node scripts/check-ad-mode.mjs live
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && node scripts/check-ad-mode.mjs test && node scripts/check-no-google.mjs && npx cap sync ios && npm run ios:pods && node scripts/check-native-sync.mjs ios test
scripts.ios:sync:adsoff: VITE_AD_MODE=test VITE_ADS=off npm run build && node scripts/check-ad-mode.mjs off && node scripts/check-no-google.mjs && npx cap sync ios && npm run ios:pods && node scripts/check-native-sync.mjs ios off
scripts.ios:sync:mock: VITE_AD_MODE=test VITE_ADS=mock npm run build && node scripts/check-ad-mode.mjs mock && node scripts/check-no-google.mjs && npx cap sync ios && npm run ios:pods && node scripts/check-native-sync.mjs ios mock
scripts.ios:appstore: VITE_AD_MODE=live npm run build && node scripts/check-ad-mode.mjs live && node scripts/check-no-google.mjs && npx cap sync ios && npm run ios:pods && node scripts/check-native-sync.mjs ios live
scripts.ios:run: npm run ios:sync:mock && rm -rf .build/ios/Build/Products && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination "id=$SIM" -derivedDataPath .build/ios CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build >/dev/null && xcrun simctl install "$SIM" .build/ios/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/App.app && { xcrun simctl terminate "$SIM" com.noqyris.foldwing 2>/dev/null || true; } && xcrun simctl launch "$SIM" com.noqyris.foldwing
scripts.release:appstore: npm run ios:appstore && { fastlane release_build; live=$?; npm run ios:sync:adsoff && fastlane beta_adsoff && [ $live -eq 0 ] && fastlane attach_build; }

levelplay.userTrackingDescription: Allows Foldwing to show ads that are more relevant to you. Declining keeps the ads, just less relevant.
